frozen_definitions.disk: def disk (x : ℚ) : Set ℂ := {z | ‖z - centre x‖ < radius x}
frozen_definitions.tangent:
def tangent (x y : ℚ) : Prop :=
  x ≠ y ∧ ∃ z : ℂ, boundary x ∩ boundary y = {z}

frozen_headers.ford_open_disjoint: theorem ford_open_disjoint (x y : ℚ) (hne : x ≠ y) : Disjoint (disk x) (disk y)
frozen_headers.ford_boundary_disjoint:
theorem ford_boundary_disjoint (x y : ℚ) (hne : x ≠ y)
  (hsep : 2 ≤ |det x y|) : Disjoint (boundary x) (boundary y)
frozen_headers.ford_tangent_iff: theorem ford_tangent_iff (x y : ℚ) (hne : x ≠ y) : tangent x y ↔ fareyAdj x y
frozen_headers.ford_real_axis: theorem ford_real_axis (x : ℚ) : boundary x ∩ realAxis = {(x : ℂ)}
frozen_headers.kiss_unique:
theorem kiss_unique (x y : ℚ) (h : fareyAdj x y) :
  boundary x ∩ boundary y = {kiss x y}
frozen_headers.two_squares:
theorem two_squares (a c : ℤ) (q s : ℤ) :
  (a*q + c*s)^2 + (a*s - c*q)^2 = (a^2 + c^2)*(q^2 + s^2)
frozen_headers.kiss_integer_identity:
theorem kiss_integer_identity (x y : ℚ) (h : fareyAdj x y) :
  (kissN x y)^2 + 1 = (x.num^2 + y.num^2) * (kissM x y : ℤ)
frozen_headers.kiss_real_identity:
theorem kiss_real_identity (x y : ℚ) (h : fareyAdj x y) :
  (kissN x y : ℝ)^2 + 1 =
    ((x.num : ℝ)^2 + (y.num : ℝ)^2) * (kissM x y : ℝ)
